analyst.text: Cleveland won at Madison Square Garden behind James Harden's season-high 32, easing some of the pressure on Kenny Atkinson. But Evan Mobley is out with a toe injury, his first absence of the season. Miami open a five-game homestand after a 3-2 West trip. Giannis Antetokounmpo is probable with a sprained wrist; he says he is "not concerned at all" and wants to move past Doc Rivers' public criticism. Giannis's edge and Mobley's absence lean slightly toward Miami.
